name: D35 Opatovec → Mohelnice

A.note: Opatovec: western end of mapped proposed D35, at the temporary service-road continuation

B.note: Mohelnice: 33.35 km along the mapped proposed D35, where it starts to merge with the existing I/35 (45 m away); the last 0.55 km of the mapped line rebuilds the existing road, which the game does not model

junction.about: I/35 carriageway ways within the merge zone of B. The merge onto I/35 is priced as one junction; the onward reconstruction of I/35 into D35 is outside this exercise.

hard.name: Greywacke / conglomerate / quartzite — uncalibrated regional prior

baselineNote: The whole D35 Opatovec → Mohelnice link, both project sections (Opatovec–Staré Město 16.6 km, Staré Město–Mohelnice 18.23 km incl. 1.33 km rebuilt existing D35; ŘSD leaflets 09/2025), as one motorway mission (built as D 27.5; the project is D 26.0/130). It ends where the mapped line starts to merge with the existing I/35 (declared merge, PROVISIONAL price, research/27–28); the last 0.6 km rebuilds the existing road and is not modelled. OSM proposed line is context, not surveyed design geometry. Ground profiles are uncalibrated regional priors.
